main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.p: Pakád, ille vir, pakedá, illa fœmina vifitavit, pakádta, tu vir, pakádt, tu fœmina vifitasti, pakádti, ego vir vel fœmina vifitavi.
Pakedú, illi viri vel fœminæ vifitarunt, pekadtèm, vos viri, pekadtén, vos fœminæ vifitastis, pakádnu, nos viri, vel fœminæ vifitavimus.

Apud Hebræos tertia persona singularis masculina, est Thema. Verba igitur, quæ in tertia persona habent terminantes vocales, -pathah, -zere, i holem, conjugantur in Paal siue Kal: ut, שָׁמַר schamár, custodivit, חָפֵץ chaphéz, voluit, יָכוֹל jachól, potuit: Et sunt aut Activa seu Transitiva levius significantia, aut

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek lines are transcribed with vowel points as far as legible; the vowel pointing on the Hebrew forms in the first heading and in the numeral lines is faint and may be imperfect. Words in the Latin paragraphs marked with a short bar or tilde (e.g. "pekadtèm", "Activa") are copied as printed; the initial capital of "Activa" is uncertain, possibly "Actiua". The page is continued on the next page, so the last paragraph is left open.
